title: Thursday Quick Tip
subtitle: A lighter week
hook: Your team looks tired. Do you push or ease up?
intro: Kids are slower and quieter at practice.
statement: Rest is part of getting better.
q1: Do you plan a lighter week now and then —
q2: or keep the same intensity all season?
q3: What are your players telling you without words?
t1: Both can work. But energy comes back
t2: when kids get a chance to recover.
cta: Coaches — do you plan lighter weeks?
ctaLines: One light week a month. Before big games. Never.
ctaPrompt: Share your practice habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Your team looks tired. Do you push or ease up?
The season is long. Kids are slower and quieter at practice.
Rest is part of getting better.
A lighter week or the same intensity. There is no perfect answer.
Do you plan lighter weeks? Share your habit in the comments.
